AN ACT to amend the election law, in relation to the compensation of election
inspectors and coordinators
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S559

SPONSOR: KRUEGER
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the election law, in relation to the compensation of
election inspectors and coordinators

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To increase the pay of election inspectors and coordinators

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Amends subdivision 1 of section 3-420 of the election law to increase
pay of election inspectors statewide to no less than $300, and election
coordinators in the city of New York from no less than $200 to no less
than $350 Amends subdivision 2 of section 3-420 of the election law to
increase Pay of election inspectors and poll clerks for required train-
ings to $50 for each meeting.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

In light of many recent election scandals around the country resulting
from unqualified election workers, New York State must attempt to
attract the most competent and well qualified inspectors and coordina-
tors for its elections. The best way to attract competent workers is to
increase compensation for those jobs. This need for competent election
inspectors and coordinators is especially important in light of the
upgrades that New York State is currently bringing to its election
equipment. As we convert our elections to electronic voting machines, we
must ensure that our inspectors and coordinators are even more competent
and well trained to deal with this new equipment.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2023-24: S.136/ A.2565 Colton - Passed Senate

2021-22: S.823A/A.4354A Colton -Passed Senate

2019-20: S.2511/A.3191 Colton - Elections Comm

2017-18: S.4170/A.7044 Colton - Elections Comm

2015-16: S.5322/A.4698 Colton - Elections Comm

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Increases compensation of election inspectors to $300 and coordinators to $350 in New York city.
